note: Why My Bill intent registry. Each bill.explain intent routes to one utility orchestrator; GENERAL never routes to tools.

intents.description: Safe fallback for greetings and questions that are not about a household bill. Replies conversationally and never routes to tools.
examples: what can you help me with?

intents.description: Explain why a household electricity bill went up or down between two bills
examples: Why was my electricity bill lower in June?
why did my power bill jump in April
what changed on my electric bill this month?

intents.description: Explain why a household gas bill went up or down between two bills
examples: Why did my gas bill go up in January?
my boiler bill was huge last month, why?
why is the gas so expensive this winter?

intents.description: Explain why a household water and sewerage bill went up or down between two bills
examples: Why did my water bill go up in June and July?
is there a leak? my water bill doubled
why is my sewerage charge higher?
